replace immutable-source sampling with chained frame-to-frame resampling
change the P9A trajectory, P9B bilinear sampler or U2.2 curve
tune the chart, frame window, controls or gates after scoring
claim this synthetic raster comparison is measured scanner mechanics or video quality
